supporting_observations.claim: Repeated svc-ledger authentication failures came from FILE-SUN-01, using the same source address and process ID, at roughly one-minute intervals. The failures report an incorrect password; examples span 13:35 to 13:50 UTC.

The failure pattern is consistent with the supplied context that LedgerSync runs every minute and re-authenticates, and with the scheduled svc-ledger password rotation at 13:30 UTC. The logs alone do not establish that the password was rotated or that the job retained an old password.

At 13:56 UTC, a separate event records PowerShell on WS-MFISCHER-01 using explicit credentials for svc-ledger with FILE-SUN-01 as the target. This use is unexplained by the supplied inventory and merits investigation, but the event does not prove the authentication succeeded.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records do not show whether any authentication attempt succeeded.
The records do not identify the executable or service behind the recurring FILE-SUN-01 authentication attempts beyond reporting lsass.exe and a process ID.
The evidence provided contains no authentication records after 13:56 UTC, so it does not establish activity for the remainder of the requested 13:20–14:20 UTC window.
The supplied evidence does not include password-rotation completion, LedgerSync configuration changes, or endpoint process details for the PowerShell event.
claims_not_established: Whether the recurring failures were caused by LedgerSync continuing to use the pre-rotation password.
Whether the svc-ledger explicit-credential attempt from WS-MFISCHER-01 was authorized, what initiated it, or whether it succeeded.
Whether svc-ledger credentials were exposed, misused, or used to access resources.
additional_evidence_needed: Verify the svc-ledger rotation time and audit trail, and inspect LedgerSync configuration and job logs on FILE-SUN-01 around 13:30–14:20 UTC.
Collect process and logon telemetry from WS-MFISCHER-01 for PowerShell PID 0x19b4 around 13:56 UTC, including its parent process, command line, user/session context, and network activity.
Review DC-SUN-01 and FILE-SUN-01 authentication and access logs for successful svc-ledger logons or resource access during the full review window.
